headline_marked: Jamaat leader [[Akhtaruzzaman granted 1-day remand]] over airport chaos
headline: Jamaat leader Akhtaruzzaman granted 1-day remand over airport chaos
summary: The court granted a one-day remand for Major (Retd) Akhtaruzzaman following allegations of obstructing government work and assaulting a security official at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport.
details: A Dhaka court has granted a one-day remand for Jamaat-e-Islami leader Major (Retd) Akhtaruzzaman after he was accused of creating chaos at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport.
The charges include obstructing government duties and assaulting a security official. The order was given by Metropolitan Magistrate Albiruni Mir on Saturday afternoon.
The incident occurred on Thursday morning when passengers from a flight from Medina, Saudi Arabia, faced a trolley shortage at the luggage belt area, leading to tension.

According to the case, airport executive director Group Captain S M Raghib Samad went to the scene to calm the situation, but Akhtaruzzaman allegedly approached him aggressively, using abusive language and threats.
Akhtaruzzaman was arrested by the Detective Branch (DB) on Friday afternoon from his residence in Cantonment DOHS, Dhaka.
During the remand hearing, Akhtaruzzaman claimed the case is a conspiracy against him, alleging that DB police arrived at his home before the case was even filed at the police station.
Upon being brought to court, he expressed anger by throwing his helmet away as Jamaat activists shouted slogans in the court premises.
caption:
A Jamaat leader is in remand after an airport luggage trolley shortage turned into a confrontation with a security official.

A Dhaka court has granted a one-day remand for Jamaat-e-Islami leader Major (Retd) Akhtaruzzaman after he was accused of creating chaos at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport.

The charges include obstructing government duties and assaulting a security official. The order was given by Metropolitan Magistrate Albiruni Mir on Saturday afternoon.

The incident occurred on Thursday morning when passengers from a flight from Medina, Saudi Arabia, faced a trolley shortage at the luggage belt area, leading to tension.

According to the case, airport executive director Group Captain S M Raghib Samad went to the scene to calm the situation, but Akhtaruzzaman allegedly approached him aggressively, using abusive language and threats.

Akhtaruzzaman was arrested by the Detective Branch (DB) on Friday afternoon from his residence in Cantonment DOHS, Dhaka.

During the remand hearing, Akhtaruzzaman claimed the case is a conspiracy against him, alleging that DB police arrived at his home before the case was even filed at the police station.

Upon being brought to court, he expressed anger by throwing his helmet away as Jamaat activists shouted slogans in the court premises.

headline: Radda vandalism: Nationalist Cyber Party VP arrested
summary: Sajjad Hossain Mishu, a former Chhatra Dal leader, is among 17 people detained in connection with the attack on a health center in Mirpur.
details: The Detective Branch (DB) of the Dhaka Metropolitan Police has arrested Sajjad Hossain Mishu, the vice-president of the Dhaka district branch of the Nationalist Cyber Party.
caption:
17 people have now been arrested following the violent attack on the Radda MCH-FP center in Mirpur.

The Detective Branch (DB) of the Dhaka Metropolitan Police has arrested Sajjad Hossain Mishu, the vice-president of the Dhaka district branch of the Nationalist Cyber Party.
